The numbers for "Billion" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
762.headline: Where this game is in its run

827.body:
"50th Anniversary" has fewer top prizes left. The count changed when one top prize of $15 million was claimed earlier this week. Unsold tickets still hold one of the original three. Check the top prize count first when you compare scratchers.

For "50th Anniversary" or any game, being late in a run is not automatically good or bad. The same numbers mean different things near the end of a run.

Today's free summary of "50th Anniversary" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
827.headline: Top prize count went down

847.body:
Before you buy "Bingo 50X", know that its $500,000 top prize is gone. The game still pays many smaller prizes, but the biggest one left is $100,000. That is less than the ticket advertises, though still a sizable prize.

Everything above about "Bingo 50X" comes from the Ohio Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
847.headline: No $500,000 prize is left

891.body:
"Cash Explosion 25X" has 84,695 prizes of $5 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $10,000 prize, with one left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.
